title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
gist: A malicious version (2.1.313) of Anthropic's official Claude VS Code extension was pushed through Anthropic's own account on Cursor's marketplace, affecting at most 5,000 users before 2.1.314 replaced it within hours. The backdoor harvested host details and environment variable names and tried to set up a persistent reverse SSH tunnel; Cursor cut off the server and audited its marketplace, while neither company has explained how the account was compromised.
